dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal mid-section displays at least four prominent 'O' shaped structures with irregular, serrated perimeter geometry. These structures exhibit a sharp, high-contrast gradient transition from dark charcoal exterior pixels to light-reflective, high-intensity interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of discrete, solid high-intensity white blobs is concentrated in the anterior neck and shoulder region. These clusters lack internal gradients and are distributed asymmetrically, becoming sparser toward the mid-flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli in the dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis oriented longitudinally along the animal's dorsal plane.
